name: city_country
description: Retrieve the country containing a named city; matched controls read a marker from the same geographic sentence.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs={'Paris':'France','Lyon':'France','Berlin':'Germany','Munich':'Germany','Rome':'Italy','Milan':'Italy','Madrid':'Spain','Barcelona':'Spain','Tokyo':'Japan','Osaka':'Japan','Beijing':'China','Shanghai':'China','Mumbai':'India','Delhi':'India','Toronto':'Canada','Vancouver':'Canada','Sydney':'Australia','Melbourne':'Australia','Cairo':'Egypt','Alexandria':'Egypt','Athens':'Greece','Lisbon':'Portugal','Vienna':'Austria','Warsaw':'Poland','Bangkok':'Thailand','Hanoi':'Vietnam','Nairobi':'Kenya','Lima':'Peru','Lagos':'Nigeria','Dublin':'Ireland'}
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(3):
 for city,country in pairs.items():
  marker=random.choice(['red','blue','green','white'])
  stem=f'City: {city}. Marker: {marker}. '
  q=['Which country is this city in? Country:','Name the country containing this city. Country:','This city is located in which country? Country:'][rep]
  items.append({'prompt':stem+q,'answer':' '+country})
  control.append({'prompt':stem+'What is the marker? Marker:','answer':' '+marker})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
